coordinateSpace: authored glTF attachment local, all node transforms applied
pose: authored rest, no rig rotations/visibility changes
method: Projected XY barycentric triangle inclusion, interpolated Z, from declared nozzle exit toward interior along -Z. Double-sided hits retained; closest front-facing/double-sided hit separately identified. No vertex-radius inference.
limitations: Geometric ray audit only; it does not qualify shaded pixels, camera exposure, hot-surface temperatures or material-dependent thermal radiation.
Authored rest includes source geometry that runtime may hide, including ladder/extras; hit identity is reported explicitly.
correction: The previous no-center-disk assertion based only on vertex radii was wrong. Perimeter-only vertices form triangles that cover the exhaust axis.
qualification: Read-only actual triangle geometry in authored rest. No GPU/render or temperature/brightness calibration.
